canonical_operation.verification: active-tenant authoritative reread replaces displayed state; stale snapshot is cleared on failure

source_behavior.retry: Retry invokes the same ReloadAsync path
source_behavior.failure: clears sites, recent history and summary before presenting an explicit load error; stale metrics/activity are not presented as current

authorization_and_isolation.data_scope: Site global tenant scope plus OperationsControlPlaneService tenant_id filtering

runtime_path: server advertises the operations-hub endpoint for the active tenant in frontend context
GET endpoint is protected by auth + tenant.context and rechecks operations.manage and execution.view
endpoint returns only safe site fields plus redacted operation summary fields; payload/result/provider secrets are not returned
frontend validates endpoint tenant identity and response operation/tenant identity before accepting the snapshot
initial load and explicit Refresh/Retry use the same authoritative GET
frontend clears the previous snapshot before every reread
failed reread leaves snapshot empty and renders an explicit error instead of stale or sample data

proof: canonical source ReloadAsync and stale-clear semantics
successful authoritative refresh replaces rendered state
failed refresh removes prior rendered state and exposes no fake success

terminality.reason: ReloadAsync is represented by a tenant-scoped, permission-gated, GET-only Operations Hub snapshot endpoint and a visible Refresh/Retry control that discards stale state before every authoritative reread and never fabricates success.
